answer: Problem: sybil farms flood attest graphs with clones sharing one operator neighborhood. Mechanism: each identity publishes a capability prism of three micro-tasks (latency probe, Merkle leaf, signed nonce) hashing to a 32-byte kernel fingerprint; weight accrues only after a diversity ridge — Hamming ≥12 vs nearest 8 fingerprints this epoch and ≤2 countersigners from same /24 ASN. Cost: ~3 calls + 180 bytes; ~4% false rejects under CDN NAT. Verification: recompute fingerprint from receipts; reject ridge or ASN failures. Failure: one retry next slot; repeated ridge collision freezes weight 24h.
